correction.description: The Q5 BFGS inverse-Hessian covariance fallback is bound to the corrected implementation. The callback is supplied directly to statsmodels 0.14.6 LikelihoodModel.fit(), where cov_params_func is accepted, and ConditionalResultsWrapper is reconstructed following native ConditionalLogit.fit() behaviour. The Q5 design matrix, coefficients, estimand, primary Wald restriction, model family, fixture and all other Q1-Q5 models are unchanged. This freeze also records the removal of two accidental syntax corruptions present in the immediately preceding implementation commit.

audit_basis.reason_gate_007_reuse_blocked: Gate 007 is bound to the superseded implementation commit/blob and therefore cannot authorize this corrected implementation.

execution_boundary.next_action: Create a new pre-execution gate bound to this freeze and corrected implementation, update isolated workflow/executor bindings, run static and runtime prechecks, then relaunch only after every precheck passes and explicit execution authorization is valid.
